play.hint.interval: Fires at fixed times measured from the start of the slot.
play.hint.loop: Repeats forever. With one file it loops on itself at its own repeat point; with several it plays them one after another.
play.hint.once: Plays through a single time and stops.
play.hint.random: Fires one file at a random gap, forever.
play.orderHint.random: Draws a different file each pass.
play.orderHint.sequential: Plays the files in the order listed, then starts over.
play.orderHint.single: One track, repeating at its own loop point. The intro plays once and the body repeats.
play.wait: Wait for the sound to finish
play.waitHint.off: Off: the gap is timed from when a sound starts, so long files can overlap.
play.waitHint.on: On: the gap starts when the sound finishes, so only one plays at a time.
